title: Questions for Justin Guthrie
excerpt: Do you remember your childhood dreams? I remember mostly nightmares vividly.
body:
Do you remember your childhood dreams?
I remember mostly nightmares vividly. Pleasant childhood dreams only occur via Déjà vu, most are mundane like a dog walking across the street and nodding at me, as if we have met somewhere before.

Morning shower or evening?
Showers only feel necessary if for to cure a headache or it’s obvious I need one.

Is there anything you regret not doing?
I regret not professing my love to every beautiful girl I see, but I understand it’s not that simple. So on second thought, I don’t regret that. I regret nothing.

What was your first job?
I worked at an ice cream shop where I had to sing if someone gave the store a tip. I did an ice cream themed rendition of Guns N’ Roses “Paradise City”

What would you put on your tombstone?
I haven’t thought that far into the future yet.

What would be your last meal?
Gun to my head…bone marrow on sour dough toast and clam chowder as the appetizer. A fatless medium rare steak with semi melted blue cheese over the top, garlic mashed potatoes. A rootbeer float for dessert. Three gin and tonics.

What are you reading?
I’m reading the autobiography of Shaun Ryder, lead singer of the Happy Mondays.

What movie have you seen the most times?
My father loved the lost boys and introduced me to the movie before I was really even conscious. My parents got divorced around this time, perhaps 3 or 4. I believe I must have associated my father with the lost boys because my mother had a real issue with me where I would wake up in the middle of the night and put the lost boys in the vcr until the static came on. So I’ve seen that one easily over a hundred times.

Thoughts on love?
Two thoughts, love is two people who subconsciously decide that their genetics would make a successful child…or it’s an untamed intertwining of spirits where there is no true explanation as to why or how, but it is realer than life itself. I’m not convinced of either.

What are your beauty secrets?
None, I am not beautiful.

How do you know when you’ve had enough?
When the hair raises on my arms and I start to juggle the consequences in my mind.

When do you get nervous?
When I can’t be myself.

What’s living on your nightstand?
Vitamins, crucifix, thermostat, 5 half read books.

Favorite thing about the city you live in?
It’s my dojo.

What makes you smile?
When I find myself in something else.

Have you been kicked out of anywhere?
Many many places, places I haven’t even been yet.

What keeps you here?
God. My greatest fear is reincarnating in a worse position than I started with. Whoever I am in the next life, I want you to be better off than I, you keep me here.
